visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an extreme close-up of an orange cat's face as it lies down, its green eyes blinking slowly. The background is a blurry wooden table leg and white floor. (2) Cut to a white and grey cat sleeping peacefully on a pink cushion against a light wood wall. (3) An orange and white cat is shown sitting on a beige textured mat next to a light blue bowl in a bright indoor room. (4) A medium shot of a brown dog lying in a sandy area outdoors under the shade of trees. (5) Close-up of a person's hands using a knife to slice pieces of raw red meat on a wooden cutting board. (6) A small grey and white kitten sits on a beige sofa, then turns and walks across a wooden floor toward a staircase. (7) Various shots follow of different cats—orange tabby, white/grey, and tortoiseshell—being fed small dark treats by a hand or sniffing at a person's finger. (8) Hands are seen again, this time cutting green broccoli florets on the same wooden board. (9) A hand holds a white and blue sachet in front of an orange cat's face by a window. (10) The final sequence shows a tabby cat and then a black cat licking the treat paste directly from the sachet as it is squeezed by the person's hand.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 貓咪一定要吃的東西？ [Logo]: 好味小姐 LADY FLAVOR. (2) [Subtitle]: 貓咪缺乏牛磺酸 會失明還有心臟病？ [Logo]: 好味小姐. (3) [Subtitle]: 到底牛磺酸是什麼呢？ (4) [Subtitle]: 牛磺酸之所以常常在貓咪界被提起 是因為我們跟狗狗呢 都可以自行合成牛磺酸 但是貓咪們不行. (5) [Subtitle]: 若長期缺乏牛磺酸 會導致視網膜病變 或是擴張性心肌症. (6) [Subtitle]: 如果是幼貓缺乏牛磺酸 則會影響他們成長的速度 造成發育不良哦！. (7) [Subtitle]: 所以長期缺乏牛磺酸 對貓咪來說的傷害 可是不可逆的呀！. (8) [Subtitle]: 那我們有需要額外幫貓咪們補充牛磺酸嗎？. (9) [Subtitle]: 成貓一天的牛磺酸建議攝取量呢 是300-400毫克. (10) [Subtitle]: 大家可以看看貓咪主食中標示的含量 是不是足夠？. (11) [Subtitle]: 若沒有呢 可以自己購買牛磺酸做添加. (12) [Subtitle]: 而且牛磺酸是水溶性胺基酸 如果不小心攝取過多 也會經由腎臟的代謝 隨著尿尿一起排出體外 所以大家不用擔心 會造成身體的負擔哦！. (13) [Subtitle]: 其實除了牛磺酸之外呢 貓咪還有很多必需胺基酸 所以大家一定要記得 讓貓咪均衡飲食 才是最健康的照顧方法哦！. (14) [Subtitle]: 如果你們擔心貓咪的主食罐 或是飼料裡面 含有的牛磺酸不夠呢. (15) [Subtitle]: 這裡推薦你 我們的好味貓肉泥條. (16) [Subtitle]: 我們添加了 貓咪每日必需營養 牛磺酸！. (17) [Subtitle]: 不僅好吃、補水 還補營養. (18) [Subtitle]: 最適合當貓咪日常的獎勵了！. (19) [Subtitle]: 我是好味小姐 養貓要知道 那你知道了嗎？
